newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIDO sees French 97 rapeseed crop at 2.88 mln T.
newsitem.headline: SIDO sees French 97 rapeseed crop at 2.88 mln T.

text.p: French oilseeds and protein seeds association SIDO said on Friday that the 1997 rapeseed crop would remain broadly in line with last year's levels as higher sowings would offset a sharp fall in yields.
In its first estimate for the 1997/98 season, SIDO forecast a 1997 crop of 2.88 million tonnes against 2.87 million in 1996.
This assumes yields would fall 10 percent to three tonnes per hectare from 3.3 tonnes last year and total area rise 11 percent to 960,000 hectares.
SIDO linked the sharp fall in yields to winter frost and spring drought damages.
The amount of set-aside land used for growing rapeseed for industrial use was expected to fall 25 percent to 160,000 hectares.
SIDO expects crushings to increase to 900,000 tonnes from 780,000 tonnes last year.
It also set an export target 1.63 million tonnes against 1.815 million last year.
France should end the 1997/98 campaign with carryover stocks of 50,000 tonnes against 30,000 tonnes at end June 1996.
